text:
infra-monitor: [ALERT] hosted-usw2-gpu-pool-A p95 queue length = 78 (>70) over 3m. Routing fallback enabled -> spill to euw1/usw3. Egress +42%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/capacity-usw2 (investigate)
nikhil: seeing increased KV-cache churn on small-chat models, might explain more requests being treated as cold starts
jess: kicking autoscaler bump for hosted-usw2-gpu-pool-A (+2 nodes) now. running: `infractl scale pool hosted-usw2-gpu-pool-A --delta 2`
ben-infra: heads-up — if traffic keeps spilling to euw1 we could hit SNAT port pressure on the NAT gateway. watch egress SNAT metrics.
carla-oncall: can we flip routing policy to prefer local spare hosts and reduce inter-region fallback? patch ready: `routingctl set-policy hosted-usw2 prefer-local-spare --ttl 15m`
deploy-bot: Patch queued: routing-policy/hosted-usw2/prefer-local-spare (PR #5421). CI passed, will apply in ~30s.
jess: applied patch, bumped pool. initial p95 dropped to 41 in 60s, now 23 after KV-cache warmup.
nikhil: looks like most of the earlier backlog was client retries due to transient 503s. suggest we throttle noisy clients at admission-control rather than global drop. propose `admissionctl set-rate client-tag:retries 5/s`
finance-signal: quick cost note — cross-region egress spike ~0.42TB in last 45m, rough bill delta ~$3.2k for the incident window. tagging for chargeback.
carla-oncall: thanks. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and leave the autoscaler bump for 10m then revert if stable. opening a follow-up doc in #eng-postmortems. :white_check_mark:
nikhil: long-term action: add per-model KV cache affinity and increase local reserve for hosted-usw2 (create ticket INFRA-8345).
ben-infra: adding SNAT alert threshold to avoid silent exhaustion next time.
carla-oncall: incident marked mitigated. please add short runbook step for prefer-local-spare policy. closing thread unless regressions show up. :lock:
